note: Build matrix for the numan#30 CI build+sign pipeline. Each active plugin is cross-compiled from its immutable upstream source_commit after its human-facing tag is verified to resolve to that commit, packaged per target (.tar.gz on Unix, .zip on Windows), and published once as a GitHub release asset on THIS repo. numan-registry then pins those asset URLs via scripts/add-package.py and signs the index with the trust root. This repo never holds signing keys.

schema_notes.intake_mode: Optional per-entry field, 'tagged' (default) or 'commit-snapshot'. All active entries must provide a non-empty 'tag' field. 'tagged' verifies the tag via git ls-remote against source_commit. 'commit-snapshot' skips the tag-to-commit ls-remote check but still requires a tag field to be present and non-empty (source_commit is confirmed fetchable upstream via a scoped shallow fetch and verified to be a commit object, not a tree/blob/tag). The workflow derives the version for commit-snapshot entries as 0.0.0-snapshot.<YYYYMMDD>.<7-char-sha> once per run (date = intake date) and uses it consistently for packaging, the release tag, and the generated spec, instead of the manifest 'version' field. gen_spec.py emits 'provenance': 'commit-snapshot' at the top level of the generated spec.
